title: Add lost-tab recovery and export
intent: Expose persisted records that no longer match open tabs so missing URLs can be reviewed, copied, exported, or reopened safely.
progress: Settings now identifies persisted HTTP(S) records not matched to open tabs, handles duplicate URLs, and supports selection, clipboard copy, JSON export, and safe reopening into the managed/fallback window. All checks pass.

checklist.text: Identify recoverable persisted records without losing duplicate URLs
Add settings UI with selection, copy, export, and reopen actions
Test recovery logic and run project checks
